name: Wallswap
author: Pavel Petržela
description: Rotates your background with fresh images from NASA APOD, Bing, Wikimedia Commons, Wallhaven or a local folder.

barWidget.description: Swaps the background on a timer. Click for the next image, right-click to open its source, middle-click to keep it in your theme's backgrounds.

schema.label: Sources
schema.description: Each swap picks one of these at random.

options.label: NASA APOD
options.description: Astronomy Picture of the Day, random from the archive

options.label: Bing
options.description: Bing image of the day, last ~2 weeks, in 4K

options.label: Wikimedia Commons
options.description: Picture of the day from the last three years

options.label: Wallhaven
options.description: Top SFW wallpapers of the year, optionally filtered by a search query

options.label: Local folder
options.description: Images from the folder set below

schema.label: Minutes between swaps
schema.description: 0 swaps only when you click the icon.

schema.label: Wallhaven search
schema.description: For example: nature, space, city night. Leave empty for the overall top list.

schema.label: NASA API key
schema.description: Optional. The shared DEMO_KEY is limited to 50 requests a day per IP; get a free key at api.nasa.gov.
